title: DARPA N3 brain-machine interface program

tellings.quote: That year DARPA launched a program called N3, [music] next generation non-surgical neurotechnology.

plain: In 2018, DARPA, the Pentagon agency that funds advanced military research, launched a program called N3, short for "next generation non-surgical neurotechnology": a way to link the brain to machines without surgery. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a 2026 episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor. He brings it up as a sign that the military was interested in reaching into the human mind.
